title: 看板按查找字段分道：空值记录全在第一页之后时，「未分类」道不显示（接 #37327）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S5(a) of the seat's L2 on PR #37511 (#37327), record 7188888406, note 7188910951; the seat asked the owning zone to card it under #37327. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: a list view's kanban laned on a lookup where every record with an empty lookup sits past page one · evidence: os-dev report 7188670345 (out-of-scope notes), L2 record 7188888406.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：看板按查找字段分道时，如果所有「未分类」（查找字段为空）的记录都在第一页之后，「未分类」这一道不会显示。
- 谁受益：用查找字段分组看板、且有空值记录的用户。
- 不做会怎样：一部分记录在看板上完全看不到入口。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- After #37327, past-page lanes are drawn from the grouped read's group keys, but the trailing Uncategorized lane is drawn only from cards (`bucketCardsIntoColumns`), so it is missing when every empty-lookup record is past page one.
- Draw it from the grouped read's null key as well, with its whole count.

## Acceptance

- In the #36871 rig, a board whose empty-lookup records all sit past page one draws the Uncategorized lane with its whole count; control: none past page one renders as today.

Blocked-by: #37327
